title: Creating a Practice sets its timer: suggested setups at create and in the editor, one Timer section, and a timer card on the Practice page

source.ref: Owner request 2026-11-19: Practices and the timer should work together end to end, setting up the timer should be easy, and Vera should offer the best timer configurations

detail:
Found by auditing the Practice and timer systems together. The timer engine and the save path were sound, but nothing led an author to them. (1) The create flow carried a timer slot nothing filled and dropped the session-length answer, so every new Practice shipped as a silent sit with no length. (2) In the editor the timer sat two thirds down the form, the length lived in another section, Get Moving had a second length, and the first mode tile read Mindless (the timer's own name) instead of Be Still. (3) The Practice page read one practice through the practices_ranked view and then asked it for timer_kind and movement_config, which that view does not expose: every timed practice described itself as Log it and a Get Moving practice's Start button had no mode. (4) Vera said nothing about the timer. (5) The Studio autosave replaced a queued edit with the next one, so a name typed and a chip tapped inside 600 ms saved only the chip, and closing inside the window dropped the edit.

DONE 2026-11-19: one closed catalog of sixteen timer setups (lib/practices/timer-setups.ts) with a plain-words description of any stored timer and an offline recommender matched to the author's own words. Vera reads the draft and picks from that catalog by ID only (lib/ai/practice-timer-suggest.ts, Haiku, its own daily cap); the owner ruling that Vera never writes an author's words stands (ADR-1939 ruling 4), every word shown is reviewed copy, and nothing applies until the author taps. The create flow shows the suggestions on review and sets the best fit unless the author picks another. The editor has one Timer section under the guide: suggested setups, Be Still / Get Moving / Log it, that mode's tuning, one length, the warm-up, and exactly what members will see. The Practice page has a timer card in the same words with the primary Start Practice button, and its read now fills the timer columns from the table. The autosave merges queued edits and sends a pending one on close. No timer screen was restyled and no schema changed. Rendered at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
